parts.text: Edit this image: give her visible short frizzy matted auburn hair in two lopsided bunches tied with dirty ribbon, sticking out from both sides of her head above the ears, with frizzy auburn hair over the top of her scalp, so she is clearly not bald. Short hair only, nothing below the jaw. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same figure, pose, face, clothing, weapons, backpack, background and the same matte clay stop-motion style.

Edit this image, three changes: 1) The cracked porcelain doll face mask must cover her WHOLE face from forehead to chin: move it up so the doll's glass eyes sit exactly where her real eyes are, and none of her real eyes, eyelids, brow or skin show above or around the mask. 2) Swap what her hands hold: the near hand on the RIGHT side of the picture now grips the small red-and-yellow toy pistol, and the other hand on the left side of the picture holds the giant red-and-cream striped circus mallet resting up on that shoulder. 3) Remove all the blue electric sparks and lightning around the backpack; it is a plain designer backpack. Keep her lace bonnet, bun, gown, the brown skull-pattern designer backpack, background and clay style exactly the same.

Edit this image: the cracked porcelain doll face mask must cover her WHOLE face from forehead to chin: move and enlarge it so the doll's glass eyes sit exactly where her real eyes are, and none of her real eyes, eyelids, brow or green skin show above or around the mask; her bonnet and hair sit on top of the mask edge. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same figure, pose, face, clothing, weapons, backpack, background and the same matte clay stop-motion style. Keep the TICKETS sign on the booth exactly as it is.

Edit this image: replace the red streetwear backpack with a battered old plastic picnic cooler strapped to her back like a backpack with rope and belts, its lid cracked open a little, the cooler visible behind her shoulder; no logo, no lettering. Keep her face, bonnet, dress, apron, meat hook, axe, hands, the meat freezer background and the clay style exactly the same.

Edit this image: give her an exclusive limited-drop streetwear backpack in bold solid fire-red ripstop with black webbing straps and black zips, clean and box-fresh against her grimy clothes, worn on her back with the straps over her shoulders and the bag visible behind her shoulder (no logo, no box patch, no lettering). Keep everything else exactly the same: the same figure, pose, face, clothing, weapons, backpack, background and the same matte clay stop-motion style.

Edit this image: this character has a bare bone skull head, and a skull has NO ears. Remove the ear completely (and any earring, gauge or tunnel ring in it); where the ear was, show the smooth side of the bone skull with the ear hole opening, matching the rest of the skull. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same figure, pose, face, clothing, weapons, backpack, background and the same matte clay stop-motion style.
